# ActionBar

> Reusable hover actions for message and response controls.

This file matches the installed `action-bar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/action-bar.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/action-bar.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

- `button`

- `@/components/control-ui/action-bar`: `ActionBar`, `ActionBarItem`, `ActionBarCopy`, `ActionBarEdit`, types `ActionBarCopyValue`, `ActionBarContextValue`, `ActionBarProps`, `ActionBarItemProps`, `ActionBarCopyProps`, `ActionBarEditProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<ActionBar>
  <ActionBarCopy />
  <ActionBarItem />
  <ActionBarEdit />
</ActionBar>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ActionBarCopy, ActionBarEdit } from "@/components/control-ui/action-bar";
import { ChatTurn } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-layout";
import { ChatMessage, ChatMessageBody, ChatMessageEditable, ChatMessageRow } from "@/components/control-ui/chat-message";

export function ActionBarExample() {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("Summarize the latest deployment notes.");

  return (
    <ChatTurn from="user" className="mx-auto max-w-xl">
      <ChatMessage from="user" density="compact">
        <ChatMessageRow>
          <ChatMessageBody>
            <ChatMessageEditable value={message} onSave={setMessage}>
              <ActionBarCopy />
              <ActionBarEdit />
            </ChatMessageEditable>
          </ChatMessageBody>
        </ChatMessageRow>
      </ChatMessage>
    </ChatTurn>
  );
}
```
